name: agent-orchestrator
description: Orchestrate accountable coding teams across Cursor, Devin, Codex, Claude, OpenCode, and other local CLI harnesses.

interface.shortDescription: Run accountable teams across coding CLIs.
interface.longDescription: The current Codex task turns one request into a native persistent goal plus a durable plan, starts an all-project dashboard, and creates bounded top-level workers across Cursor, Devin, Codex, Claude, OpenCode, Grok, and other installed harnesses. It resolves models by cost, quality, risk, and evidence; blocks hidden nested subagents where enforceable; asks in chat and the dashboard before escalation; and requires diff and test evidence before acceptance.
defaultPrompt: Use Agent Orchestrator for this. Default to cost-first, write the plan and goal automatically, and keep the review gates strict.
Use Agent Orchestrator with quality over cost. Choose installed Sol or Opus executors at the right effort for the risk, but do not use Astra.
Use Agent Orchestrator with maximum quality. Create the durable plan, use the strongest installed bounded executors, and keep me updated in chat and the dashboard.
